scripts.build: npm --workspace @admin-board/api run build && npm --workspace @admin-board/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @admin-board/api run lint && npm --workspace @admin-board/web run lint
scripts.test: npm --workspace @admin-board/api run test && npm --workspace @admin-board/web run test
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c auto "PORT=3001 CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173 npm run dev:api" "VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:3001: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c auto "PORT=3002 CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3001 npm run dev:api" "VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3002 npm --workspace @admin-board/web run dev -- --port 3001 --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.dev:setup: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.dev:3001:setup: npm run setup && npm run dev:3001
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
